description: This file defines and exports configuration functions for Chromium command-line switches, including disabling/enabling specific features and setting various startup flags for the Chromium browser in the context of Playwright automation.

methods.name: disabledFeatures
methods.description: Returns an array of feature flags to disable in Chromium, optionally including 'AutomationControlled' if assistantMode is true.

methods.name: chromiumSwitches
methods.description: Returns an array of Chromium command-line switches based on parameters such as assistantMode, channel, and android, to configure browser startup options and feature toggles.

ctags.name: chromiumSwitches
ctags.pattern: /^export const chromiumSwitches = (assistantMode?: boolean, channel?: string, android?: boolean) =/
